QuestInfo.name: Owner of the Hat
QuestInfo.0: You found a hat while fighting Shades. What were they doing with this? Find Jake at the Subway Ticketing Booth and find out whose hat it is.
QuestInfo.1: Was the hat's owner attacked by Shades? You need some otherworldly help for this one. Ask #bJane Doe#k at Naora Hospital for help.
QuestInfo.2: Was the hat's owner attacked by Shades? You need some otherworldly help for this one. Ask #bJane Doe#k at Naora Hospital for help.

0.3: If there's one thing worse than Stirges, it's ghosts. Anyway, I hope you find whoever this hat belonged to.
0.0: Hey! I'm happy to see you. What's up?\r\n#L0# #bIs this your hat?#l\n#k
0.1: Let's take a look. Nope, this isn't mine. Where'd you find it?\r\n#L0##bIt was at Line 2 Area 3.#l\n#k
0.2: Ah... No way... I heard a scream this time when I was passing by, and I hear that the place is haunted...\r\n#L0##bCome on! Someone just must've dropped it! (Maybe there is a ghost here, though. Maybe Jane Doe can help you figure this out.) #l\n#k

1.0: I get it now... There's no going back... Why have you come here...?

npc.0: If there really is a ghost in the Subway, I wonder if it knows the ghost in Naora Hospital? Man, I'm getting the creeps!
